sents.t: Oh, it's just the greatest thing that humans ever made. The Vespa.
sents.zh: 哦，那可是人类有史以来造出的最棒的东西。韦士柏
bkw: 曾经；（跟最高级连用）有史以来

sents.t: You just sit on it and it takes you anywhere you want to go in the whole stinkin' world!
sents.zh: 你只要坐上去，它就能带你去这整个世界上任何你想去的地方！

sents.t: Are you gonna make one? I think you have all the parts.
sents.zh: 你要造一辆吗？我觉得零件你都有了

sents.t: I do have the parts. I am gonna make one! You wanna help?
sents.zh: 我确实有零件。我真的要造一辆！你想帮忙吗

sents.t: Me? Yeah! Wait. No. I can't. I gotta go home!
sents.zh: 我？好啊！等等，不行，我不能。我得回家了！

sents.t: Yeah. If my parents found out I was up here... it would be bad.
sents.zh: 对。要是我爸妈发现我上来了……就糟了
bkw: 发现；得知（find out 的过去式）

sents.t: So thank you, but... goodbye. Forever.
sents.zh: 所以谢谢你，不过……再见了。永别了

cards.zh: 曾经；（跟最高级连用）有史以来
cards.ex: Ever means at any time. After words like “the greatest,” it means “of all time.”
exs: This is the best pizza I have ever eaten.
cards.note: Day 6 原句：“Oh, it's just the greatest thing that humans ever made. The Vespa.”（哦，那可是人类有史以来造出的最棒的东西。韦士柏）

cards.ex: Stinkin' is a casual way to say stinking. People use it to make a word stronger. “The whole stinkin' world” means the whole big world.
exs: I looked in every stinkin' drawer, but I still couldn't find my keys.
cards.note: Day 6 原句：“You just sit on it and it takes you anywhere you want to go in the whole stinkin' world!”（你只要坐上去，它就能带你去这整个世界上任何你想去的地方！）

cards.zh: 发现；得知（find out 的过去式）
cards.ex: Found out is the past form of find out. It means you learned something that was hidden or that you did not know before.
exs: When Mom found out about the broken window, she was not happy.
cards.note: Day 6 原句：“Yeah. If my parents found out I was up here... it would be bad.”（对。要是我爸妈发现我上来了……就糟了）

items.zh: 曾经；（跟最高级连用）有史以来
items.ex: Ever means at any time. After words like “the greatest,” it means “of all time.”
exs: This is the best pizza I have ever eaten.
exzh: 这是我吃过的最好吃的披萨。

items.ex: Stinkin' is a casual way to say stinking. People use it to make a word stronger. “The whole stinkin' world” means the whole big world.
exs: I looked in every stinkin' drawer, but I still couldn't find my keys.
exzh: 我把每个该死的抽屉都翻遍了，还是没找到钥匙。

items.zh: 发现；得知（find out 的过去式）
items.ex: Found out is the past form of find out. It means you learned something that was hidden or that you did not know before.
exs: When Mom found out about the broken window, she was not happy.
exzh: 妈妈发现窗户被打破时，很不高兴。

items.s: Oh, it's just the greatest thing that humans ___ made. The Vespa.
items.why: ever 修饰后面的动词 made，和 the greatest 连用，表示“有史以来”。它是副词。
items.ft: Oh, it's just the greatest thing that humans ever made. The Vespa.

items.s: You just sit on it and it takes you anywhere you want to go in the whole ___ world!
items.why: the whole 和名词 world 中间用形容词。stinkin' 是 stinking 的口语写法，用来加强语气。
items.ft: You just sit on it and it takes you anywhere you want to go in the whole stinkin' world!

items.s: Yeah. If my parents ___ I was up here... it would be bad.
items.why: If my parents 后面讲的是假设的事，用过去式。found out 是 find out 的过去式，表示“发现”。
items.ft: Yeah. If my parents found out I was up here... it would be bad.
